soldier: Soldier head chestnut brown, mandibles blackish brown, pronotum slightly paler than the head, head capsule sparsely haired. Head capsule rectangular, the sides parallel, the posterior margin straight at the centre. Fontanelle small, a flat pore, 0.73 mm from the frontal margin. Labrum semicircular. The antennae are broken off, the flange over the antennal socket rather large but not covering the sides of the head completely. The broad region of the postmentum appears to bear a small median elevation, the waist region broad and long. Mandibles stout, the apices rather straight, the mandibular basal ridge visible. Pronotum kidney-shaped, the anterior margin broadly V-shaped, the lateral margins joining the posterior margin in a semicircle, the posterior margin inconspicuously concave at the centre, the median area with 2 long hairs interspersed with a few short hairs.
